chadhavaDetail.notAvailable: This chadhava is not available for booking.

chadhavaDetail.faq1q: What is Chadhava and how does it benefit devotees?
chadhavaDetail.faq1a: Chadhava is a sacred offering made with devotion at the temple during puja. It helps devotees express sankalp, seek blessings, and spiritually participate in temple rituals even if they are not physically present.
chadhavaDetail.faq2q: Can I offer multiple Chadhava items in a single booking?
chadhavaDetail.faq2a: Yes. You can select multiple offering items and quantities in one booking. Your total amount is calculated automatically before payment.
chadhavaDetail.faq3q: How will I know that my Chadhava has been offered?
chadhavaDetail.faq3a: After successful booking, your order is recorded in your account. You can track status updates from your booking details and contact support if you need confirmation.
chadhavaDetail.faq4q: Can I book Chadhava for a specific date or occasion?
chadhavaDetail.faq4a: Yes. If a specific event date is available for the selected Chadhava, your offering is scheduled accordingly. Please book before the event cut-off time for timely inclusion.
chadhavaDetail.faq5q: Can I book Chadhava on behalf of my family members?
chadhavaDetail.faq5a: Yes, you can book on behalf of family members or loved ones. Please make sure the sankalp details shared during booking are correct.
chadhavaDetail.faq6q: What happens if I miss the event date after booking?
chadhavaDetail.faq6a: If your payment is successful before the cut-off, your Chadhava is usually processed for that event. For edge cases or delays, please connect with support to verify the final status.
chadhavaDetail.faq7q: Whom should I contact for Chadhava booking support?
chadhavaDetail.faq7a: For any issue related to booking, payment, or status, please use the contact options available in the app/site support section. Our team will assist you promptly.

pujaDetail.closedAlert: Puja booking is closed for this listing.
pujaDetail.notAvailable: This puja is not available for booking.
pujaDetail.bullet1: The Puja will be performed by qualified Veda Pandits by following the right Puja Vidhi.
pujaDetail.bullet2: The Prasad will be delivered to your door step within 7-10 days and the puja video will be sent to your whatsapp within 24-48 hrs.
pujaDetail.bullet3: Since the Puja will be conducted at an auspicious time (at Shubh Muhurat), you will definitely get good results.
pujaDetail.include1: The participant's name and gotra will be recited by an experienced Panditji during the puja.
pujaDetail.include2: Participants will receive guided mantras and step-by-step instructions to join the puja from home.
pujaDetail.include3: A complete video of the puja and offerings will be shared on your WhatsApp.
pujaDetail.include4: A free Aashirwad Box with Tirth Prasad will be delivered to your home if you opt in to receive it.
pujaDetail.includesNote: Opt for additional offerings like Vastra Daan, Anna Daan, Deep Daan, or Gau Seva in your name, available on the payments page.
pujaDetail.faq1q: Why should I choose Shri aaum for performing a Puja?
pujaDetail.faq1a: Shri aaum is an official temple partner with experienced pandits. We offer transparent pricing, real-time puja updates, and delivery of prasad to your doorstep.
pujaDetail.faq2q: I don't know my Gotra, what should I do?
pujaDetail.faq2a: You can leave the Gotra field blank or select "Unknown". Our team can also help you find it if you know your family deity or lineage.
pujaDetail.faq3a: Experienced and qualified pandits from the temple perform the puja on your behalf. All devotees' names are recited during the collective puja.
pujaDetail.faq4q: What will be done in this Puja?
pujaDetail.faq4a: The puja includes mantra chanting, havan, and rituals as per the specific puja you select. Details are mentioned in the puja description.
pujaDetail.faq5q: How will I know the Puja has been done in my name?
pujaDetail.faq5a: You will receive real-time updates on your registered WhatsApp number. A complete video of the puja is also shared within 3-4 days.
pujaDetail.faq6q: What will I get after the Puja is done?
pujaDetail.faq6a: You receive the puja video on WhatsApp and an optional Aashirwad Box with Tirth Prasad delivered to your doorstep.
pujaDetail.faq7q: What are the other services offered by Shri aaum?
pujaDetail.faq7a: We offer various pujas, Gau Seva, Deep Daan, Vastra Daan, Anna Daan, and other devotional services at partner temples.
pujaDetail.faq8q: Where can I contact for more information?
pujaDetail.faq8a: You can reach us via the contact details on our website or through the customer support option during checkout.
